description: Migrate all notebooks from source to target.

action.description: Conflict strategy applied to every notebook.

examples.user_query: Migrate all notebooks, skipping any that already exist.
examples.notes: This call migrates all notebooks from the source to the target environment, skipping any notebooks that already exist in the target.

examples.user_query: How can I migrate all notebooks and overwrite any existing ones?
examples.notes: This call migrates all notebooks from the source to the target environment, overwriting any notebooks that already exist in the target.

examples.user_query: I want to migrate all notebooks but create duplicates if there are conflicts.
examples.notes: This call migrates all notebooks from the source to the target environment, creating duplicates for any notebooks that already exist in the target. The concurrency level is set to 5 to process multiple notebooks simultaneously.

description: Migrate specific notebooks from source to target.

notebook_ids.description: Notebook IDs to migrate. Provide either this or ``notebook_names``.

notebook_names.description: Notebook display names to migrate. Provide either this or ``notebook_ids``.

action.description: Conflict strategy when a notebook with the same ``displayName`` already exists on the target. - ``"skip"`` — leave the existing notebook unchanged. - ``"overwrite"`` — delete the existing notebook then recreate from source. - ``"duplicate"`` — always create, regardless of conflicts.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of notebooks to migrate concurrently, run via a background thread pool (``asyncio.to_thread``) since the underlying HTTP client is synchronous. Notebooks are independent of each other, so any value is safe. Values <= 1 (the default) process notebooks one at a time.

examples.user_query: Migrate all notebooks by their IDs, skipping any that already exist.
examples.notes: This call migrates the specified notebooks by their IDs and skips any notebooks that already exist on the target.

examples.user_query: How can I migrate notebooks named 'Sales Analysis' and 'Marketing Insights', overwriting any existing ones?
examples.notes: This call migrates the specified notebooks by their display names and overwrites any existing notebooks with the same names on the target.

examples.user_query: Migrate notebooks with IDs 'notebook_001' and 'notebook_002', creating duplicates if they already exist.
examples.notes: This call migrates the specified notebooks by their IDs and creates duplicates on the target even if notebooks with the same names already exist.
